response.justification: While Bogdan possesses strong technical fundamentals with 20+ years of engineering experience and proficiency in required programming languages, this Principal-level role demands specialized expertise in experimentation platforms, metrics infrastructure, and growth measurement systems. His background is primarily full-stack product development and general infrastructure work, with no demonstrated experience in A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, telemetry systems, or designing measurement platforms used across multiple teams. The significant gap in specialized domain expertise makes him an insufficient fit for this Principal-level position.
strengths: Extensive 20+ year track record shipping production systems across multiple languages, platforms, and domains with demonstrated ability to learn and master new technologies
Proven ability to work at enterprise scale with experience handling millions of requests per second and managing complex distributed systems at Dunnhumby and Optilyz
Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, organizing engineering development programs (code dojos, workshops), and building open-source platforms used by multiple organizations
concerns: No demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, or feature-flagging systems that are core responsibilities for this role
Lacks expertise in metrics, telemetry infrastructure, and statistical/data analysis methods critical for growth measurement systems at Principal level
Career shows breadth across many domains rather than specialized depth in growth systems and measurement platforms used by multiple product teams

key_factors.factor: Missing experimentation platform and metrics expertise
20+ years technical depth and production scale experience
